meta.title: Web Runtime Platform Module
meta.summary: Creator 与诊断 Host 共用一个受 Product Assembly 约束的浏览器 Runtime

cards.title: Product identity
cards.body: Product CMake 注入 Product Build、Platform version 与精确 Host triple。

cards.title: Shared runtime
cards.body: 两个 Host 共用 frame-stamped input、BPM-safe overlay、exact boundary flush、bounded Stop replay 与 fail-closed owner-loss cleanup。 Strict retained-Project routing, explicit permission readback and target plan. Facade prepares transient PCM; Host audition pool reports actual admission and consumes stop. Serialize adoption once; unknown response requires inspection. No Host bundle parsing or automatic retry.

cards.title: Master tap
cards.body: Platform 自有 master tap worklet；capture 状态沿 unconfigured → configured → ready 前进，失败为 unavailable，capture 只能从 ready 启动，每条消息逐键校验。

cards.title: Forbidden boundary
cards.body: Project Bundle 只进入 Facade，不连接 Creator internals，也不替代 Project Truth。Transport T0 conformance: executor owns paused OPFS while Control admits live press/release. Resume, verify bytes, consume once, release on owner thread and reacquire on a new worker. T3: opted-in sessions reach the Facade-owned transport coordinator through pattern.transport.request/inspect; the pending ticket releases the dispatch tail and the service cadence settles short epoch-checked steps. Legacy stays default. The Pattern transport live overlay: the Facade coordinator owns publication on the control cadence; the Platform implements the publish capability and keeps servicing an open recording (#1550).
